common.name: Name
keys.title: API keys
keys.limit.label: {group} limit $
keys.limit.hint: Limits cap a key's spend at API list prices, counted since the key was created; it never resets. A limited key cannot use models without a price.
keys.models.label: Allowed models (none checked = all)
keys.models.not_offered: No account offers this model now
keys.created.title: Key for {name}
keys.created.note: Copy it now. It is shown only once; the server keeps only its hash.
keys.col.hash.hint: Hex SHA-256 of the whole key; hover for all of it. Check a key with: printf %s 'sk-agyrelay-…' | sha256sum
keys.col.totals.hint: Successful calls since the key was created. Input includes cached tokens; output includes reasoning. Hover a key's numbers for each model.
keys.edit.title: Edit {name}
keys.revoke.confirm: Revoke the key {name}? Clients using it stop working at once.
keys.delete.confirm: Delete the key {name}? This cannot be undone. Its spend and totals are dropped and the name is freed; its calls stay in the history.
settings.title: Settings
settings.reset.title: Reset to the default: {value}
settings.idle_close.hint: An idle session is closed in agy after this, and its worker process (~250 MiB) exits. The conversation's next request reopens it from disk in a few seconds.
settings.direct: Allow direct connections for accounts with no proxy at all
settings.outbound.note: Every agy connects only to agyrelay's local egress proxy, which forwards through the account's proxy, else the fallback proxy, else directly when allowed.
settings.context_check.hint: Counts every prompt with the model's tokenizer; the tokenizers take about 55 MiB and load in 0.2 s
settings.windows.note: A prompt estimated above its model's window fails with context_length_exceeded before it reaches an account, so clients compact the conversation without spending quota. Models without a row are left to upstream's limit. Estimates run above upstream's count: about 1-2k tokens on Gemini and gpt-oss, up to 15% on Claude.

settings.prices.summary.one: API list prices ({count} model, USD per 1M tokens)
settings.prices.summary.other: API list prices ({count} models, USD per 1M tokens)

settings.prices.note: Input is uncached prompt tokens; output includes reasoning. agy does not report cache writes, so when a model has a cache-write price, all its uncached input is priced at it.
password.title: Admin password
password.changed: Password changed; other sessions were signed out
browsers.title: Signed-in browsers
audit.title: Audit log
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add one above.
accounts.proxy.hint: agy's traffic, sign-in included, goes through this HTTP proxy
accounts.proxy.prompt:
HTTP proxy for {name}, empty = the fallback in Settings.
Open connections close and agy reconnects through the new route.
accounts.signin.title: Sign in
accounts.signin.step1: {link} and sign in with the account to add.
accounts.signin.step2: Google sends you to antigravity.google. Copy that page's full URL (or the code it shows) and paste it here.
accounts.signin.code: Paste the code or the whole URL of the page you landed on
accounts.import.title: Import token
accounts.import.hint: A refresh token (1//…) or JSON holding one: agy's token file, a CLIProxyAPI or Antigravity Manager export. Antigravity sign-ins of personal accounts only.
accounts.imported_verify: Imported, but Google asks for the account to be verified first; see its card
accounts.verify: Google asks this account's owner to verify it, so it is out of rotation. Open the page below in a browser signed in to this Google account, finish the check there (usually a QR code scanned with the phone and a text message), then Refresh quota.
accounts.verify.no_link: Google named no page; search the agy logs for validation_url on
accounts.quota.none: No quota sample yet. Refresh to check the account.
accounts.sampled_when_running: agy not running: quota is checked again once a request or Refresh starts it
accounts.routing.title: Routing
accounts.routing.priority.hint: Higher numbers take requests first while the account has free worker slots; equal priorities use key affinity
accounts.routing.models: Routed models (none checked = all the account offers)
accounts.models.title: Models
accounts.models.hint: Grouped by the accounts that offer them. Limits and notices come from the model catalog Google sent agy, before agyrelay's rewrite; hover a model for its whole record.

accounts.models.unreported.one: {count} account has not reported its models yet.
accounts.models.unreported.other: {count} accounts have not reported their models yet.

accounts.models.unknown: Models: known once agy opens a session (a request or Refresh quota)
accounts.remove.confirm: Remove {name}? Its running turns fail, and its sign-in and stored sessions are deleted from disk.
process.front: The agy front process (one per account and client tool set); it hands each session to its own worker process
process.worker: A worker process, running the session listed
turn_state.starting: The session is opening, resuming, or rewinding
turn_state.waiting for tool results: Waits for the request that carries the results of its client tool calls
turn_state.running unobserved: No client is reading the turn, e.g. after its client disconnected; it is being cancelled or handed to the next request
workers.title: Workers
workers.logs.title: agy logs
workers.logs.partial: only the last 4 MiB read of {files}
workers.restart.confirm: Restart {name}'s agy? Its running turns fail; sessions reopen from disk on their next request.
workers.no_procs: No agy running. The next request or quota refresh starts one.
workers.closed.hint: Closed in agy after being idle; its next request reopens it from disk
workers.cancel_turn.confirm: Cancel the turn of {key}? Its client gets an error.
mode.continue: Returned tool results to the turn waiting for them; the same agy turn went on
mode.warm: Reused the agy session that holds this conversation; only the new messages were sent
mode.rewind: Rewound an agy session that holds a later version of this conversation (the client edited or dropped messages) to the shared part, then sent the rest
mode.fresh: A new conversation: a new agy session with nothing to replay
mode.replay: A new agy session that got the whole history as text, because no session could be reused (see the reason)
replay.no_snapshot: No session holds this conversation's history: new to the relay, idle past the snapshot TTL, or the history was edited
replay.tools_changed: The client's tool set differs from the session's
replay.warm_failed: The session could not be reopened or rewound
replay.retry: An earlier attempt failed on another account
status.tool_calls: The reply ended on tool calls; the turn waits for their results
status.length: The reply hit the output token limit
status.quota: The account's quota ran out, after trying another account when there was one
status.key_limit: The API key hit its spend or worker limit
status.unavailable: No account was free, or an internal check failed
status.forbidden: The API key may not use this model
calls.title: Calls
calls.total.quota.hint: Per account: 100% = that account's whole weekly bucket. Plans differ in bucket size, so accounts are not added up.
calls.cost.hint: Quota: a call's share of its account's weekly bucket; for a key, the average over the accounts with that bucket

calls.unpriced.one: {count} call of a model without a price
calls.unpriced.other: {count} calls of models without a price

calls.quota_average.hint: Average over the accounts with each group's weekly bucket (an unused account counts as 0). By account:
calls.quota_pending.hint: Google's quota shows use about 5 minutes late: attributed once the account has had no request for about 6 minutes
quota_skip.before_sampling: The account's quota was first checked after this request
quota_skip.reset: The weekly quota reset before this request's use showed
quota_skip.no_bucket: The account's plan has no weekly quota for this model group
quota_skip.missed: Missed by an earlier agyrelay version
calls.effort.hint: Effort tier sent to agy, after mapping the client's reasoning effort
calls.requests.note: A turn that calls client tools spans several requests; its tokens are counted on the request that ends it.
logs.title: Logs
